block.http_request.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.http_request.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.http_request.model.title: HTTP Request
block.http_request.model.description: Call one explicitly configured API origin with bounded JSON/text responses and wallet-backed authentication.
block.http_request.help_base_url: Only this origin and path prefix are allowed. Requests cannot replace the destination.
block.http_request.help_allowed_methods: Explicit allowed methods. Default GET and HEAD; mutations need deliberate configuration.
block.http_request.help_auth_mode: The wallet resolves credentials server-side. Inputs never set authentication headers.
block.http_request.help_secret_ref: Secret reference, never the credential itself. Required for bearer or custom-header authentication.
block.http_request.help_auth_header: Custom authentication header when mode is header, for example X-API-Key. Routing headers are forbidden.
block.http_request.help_timeout_sec: Total call deadline, including DNS, redirects and all pages. Cancellation terminates the owned worker.
block.http_request.help_max_request_byte: Maximum UTF-8 JSON input bytes, including the body.
block.http_request.help_max_response_byt: Maximum accumulated response body bytes across all pages. No truncated success.
block.http_request.help_max_pages: GET pagination via a constrained Link rel=next header; same origin and root. One page disables automatic pagination.
block.http_request.help_follow_redirects: GET/HEAD only, at most two redirects, same allowed origin and root. Mutations are never replayed.
block.http_request.help_allow_private_ne: Allow loopback/private LAN destinations explicitly. Link-local, metadata and multicast destinations remain denied.
block.http_request.help_allow_insecure_h: Allow unencrypted HTTP without credentials. Authentication still requires verified HTTPS.
block.http_request.help_ca_file: Optional existing PEM CA file for a private HTTPS service. Empty uses system trust; TLS verification cannot be disabled.
